data: What is the value of the orange line at the 60% conversation segment in the rightmost graph?

The orange line represents the mean naive distance for risk-assessed conversations. The rightmost graph shows the percentage of utterances with questions (% ?s) for both risk-assessed (orange) and non-risk-assessed (black) conversations across different conversation segments. At the 60% conversation segment, the orange line (representing risk-assessed conversations) is approximately at 55%. Therefore, the value of the orange line at the 60% conversation segment in the rightmost graph is around 55%.
